title: Denpa Onna to Seishun Otoko: Mayonaka no Taiyou
justification: AniList 10638 (OVA, 1 episode(s) from 2012-02-08) is AniDB 7903's special(s) S2, aired 2012-02-08. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 9379, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 7903, and the special's title matches an AniList title. On TMDB 65356 the parent's node places the special(s) where TMDB's dates disagree (S2 lands on TMDB 65356 S0E2, which TMDB does not list), so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
